verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS cap-table platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a read-only MCP connection and an llms.txt help index; there is no documented public versioned API or deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The MCP access is an adjacent feature, not versioned APIs with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
